title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 repair after review 19.4.6.7 S1-S4 with user decisions (attempt 5)
description: Repair PR #656 per review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.7 (read all of it) and the user's 2026-10-13 decisions recorded in bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent (run bd recall magic-item-faithful-or-absent FIRST; read the REFINEMENTS 2026-10-13 section). (S1) KEPT activation fields missing where the printed gate is in a section header or not in the producer draft: Sun Blade manifest/dismiss 'While grasping the hilt' -> equipment [['held']] (replace the old no-equipment expectation); Scarab of Protection turn-failed-save-into-success 'while it is on your person' header -> [['on-person']]; Ring of Spell Turning reflect 'while wearing' -> [['worn']]; Dragon Scale Mail sense-nearest-dragon and Well of Many Worlds open-portal printed 'action' costs -> cost 'action'. Then SWEEP all 362 operations for the same class (governing header or paragraph-level worn/held/attuned/on-person gate; printed non-spell action/bonus-action/reaction cost) without inferring unprinted restrictions; carry each missing governing sentence verbatim; extend the kept-field agreement invariant to non-spell operations and header-scoped gates. (S2) USER DECISION - single-lifetime only: re-check all 24 kept machines; keep typed only if the item owns exactly ONE lifetime at a time (or the machine is needed by a green operation or an existing runtime consumer, e.g. Cube of Force); machines whose activation can create repeatable or independently-timed instances (Staff of Swarming Insects, Helm of Brilliance, and any sibling) become DM-adjudicated with verbatim spans; for each such multi-instance item power ensure the corresponding mechanics.effects entry carries its PRINTED duration as a typed field (so capability eshyra-olc5.11 can bind start_effect to it without a pack change) - if the duration lives only in the withheld machine, add it exactly to the effect. (S3) USER DECISION - soft-limit cost: add an exact marker to the operation cost entry (e.g. cost[].onExhausted: 'risk-adjudicated', validated in packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts) for Ring of X-ray Vision and Wind Fan (and any sibling with a printed safe-use count plus risky reuse): spend a safe use while one remains; when none remain the operation is still permitted and the printed risk sentence is adjudicated; make itemState cost resolution honour it so the typed contract no longer hard-refuses risky reuse, WITHOUT making any operation newly executable (keep the same 19 ready). (S4) Iron Flask released-flask-creature: remove the duration {1 hour} and revertOn one-hour-control-ended (a control clock, adjudicated policy); keep creature/count and the initialization occupancy core; the printed friendliness paragraph stays adjudicated. Sweep grants for any other kept duration/revertOn that times control rather than existence. RUNTIME SAFETY: readiness comparison over all combinations - same 19 ready; check toolUseItem, toolSpendUsage, toolResetUsage, toolRestoreUsage, itemState, itemResetExecutor, usageCounters, itemRandomInitialization, magicItemVariants, discovery. Evidence: generalized invariants per class (kept-field agreement incl. headers/non-spell costs; single-lifetime admission incl. first/repeated use and two targets for any kept toggle; soft-limit first-use/reuse/reset with hard-limit controls; grant duration role existence-vs-control) with representative eligible/ineligible cases, not per-item reproducers. Regenerate pack + inventory; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack; update registry/inventory text truthfully. STOP CONDITION: if any kept category still looks unlikely to converge or cannot be verified cheaply, record it as a candidate to surface to the user with evidence instead of forcing it. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: per-finding table, sweep totals, readiness comparison; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes:
